method: QUOTED UNDER A 200-WORD BUDGET (198 words used), from Cancer Council Australia 'COSA Neuroendocrine Neoplasms (NENs) Guidelines' v1.0 (published 2023-10-31), retrieved 2026-09-23 as MAGICapp JSON. Every pass claim is machine re-checkable. LICENCE: Free to read, NOT openly licensed. Cancer Council Australia's guideline FAQ: fair dealing needs only correct citation; reproducing 'more than 200 words or figures/tables' needs permission from guidelines@cancer.org.au. So quotes here are capped at 200 words per source guideline (enforced by the generator) and tables were stripped from the retrieved text before quoting, so none can be quoted.

claims.claim: **Make individualised treatment decisions for NENs routinely in a multidisciplinary setting.**
claims.source_text: Decisions regarding individualised treatment for neuroendocrine neoplasms (NENs) should routinely be made in a multidisciplinary setting.
claims.locator: Cancer Council Australia, 'COSA Neuroendocrine Neoplasms (NENs) Guidelines', v1.0, published 2023-10-31, MAGICapp https://app.magicapp.org/#/guideline/jlAbxL, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Serum chromogranin A can be falsely elevated**, for example by proton pump inhibitors, **and assays differ, so use the same assay for the one patient.**
claims.source_text: Serum Chromogranin A levels can be falsely elevated … for example proton pump inhibitors … the same assay should be used for the one patient
claims.locator: Cancer Council Australia, 'COSA Neuroendocrine Neoplasms (NENs) Guidelines', v1.0, published 2023-10-31, MAGICapp https://app.magicapp.org/#/guideline/jlAbxL, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Screen patients with functional NENs every 6-12 months for carcinoid heart disease, including an annual echocardiogram.**
claims.source_text: Patients with functional NENs should be screened every 6-12 months for carcinoid heart disease (including annual echocardiogram).
claims.locator: Cancer Council Australia, 'COSA Neuroendocrine Neoplasms (NENs) Guidelines', v1.0, published 2023-10-31, MAGICapp https://app.magicapp.org/#/guideline/jlAbxL, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Valvular abnormalities on echocardiogram should prompt early cardiology referral, even if the patient is asymptomatic.**
claims.source_text: Valvular abnormalities from carcinoid heart disease detected on echocardiogram should prompt an early cardiology referral, even if asymptomatic.
claims.locator: Cancer Council Australia, 'COSA Neuroendocrine Neoplasms (NENs) Guidelines', v1.0, published 2023-10-31, MAGICapp https://app.magicapp.org/#/guideline/jlAbxL, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Surgical metastasectomy is not recommended for Grade 3 NET or neuroendocrine carcinoma.**
claims.source_text: Surgical metastasectomy is not recommended for Grade 3 NET or neuroendocrine carcinoma.
claims.locator: Cancer Council Australia, 'COSA Neuroendocrine Neoplasms (NENs) Guidelines', v1.0, published 2023-10-31, MAGICapp https://app.magicapp.org/#/guideline/jlAbxL, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Recommended starting dose for an anti-proliferative effect: octreotide LAR 30 mg or lanreotide 120 mg every 4 weeks.**
claims.source_text: The recommended starting dose … when used for an anti-proliferative effect is Octreotide LAR 30mg or Lanreotide 120mg every 4 weeks
claims.locator: Cancer Council Australia, 'COSA Neuroendocrine Neoplasms (NENs) Guidelines', v1.0, published 2023-10-31, MAGICapp https://app.magicapp.org/#/guideline/jlAbxL, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Withhold long-acting SSA therapy at least four weeks before somatostatin scintigraphy.**
claims.source_text: Long-acting SSA therapy should be withheld at least four weeks prior to somatostatin scintigraphy.
claims.locator: Cancer Council Australia, 'COSA Neuroendocrine Neoplasms (NENs) Guidelines', v1.0, published 2023-10-31, MAGICapp https://app.magicapp.org/#/guideline/jlAbxL, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Consider platinum/etoposide chemotherapy first-line for advanced Grade 3 poorly-differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas.**
claims.source_text: Platinum/etoposide chemotherapy should be considered as first-line treatment for patients with advanced Grade 3, poorly-differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas
claims.locator: Cancer Council Australia, 'COSA Neuroendocrine Neoplasms (NENs) Guidelines', v1.0, published 2023-10-31, MAGICapp https://app.magicapp.org/#/guideline/jlAbxL, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Offer routine MEN 1 surveillance screening to everyone diagnosed with MEN 1, starting by age 12 years.**
claims.source_text: Routine MEN 1 surveillance screening should be offered to all patients with a diagnosis of MEN 1 commencing by age 12 years.
claims.locator: Cancer Council Australia, 'COSA Neuroendocrine Neoplasms (NENs) Guidelines', v1.0, published 2023-10-31, MAGICapp https://app.magicapp.org/#/guideline/jlAbxL, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Functioning phaeochromocytomas and paragangliomas require pre-operative alpha-blockade to control blood pressure.**
claims.source_text: Functioning tumours require pre-operative alpha-blockade to achieve blood pressure control.
claims.locator: Cancer Council Australia, 'COSA Neuroendocrine Neoplasms (NENs) Guidelines', v1.0, published 2023-10-31, MAGICapp https://app.magicapp.org/#/guideline/jlAbxL, retrieved 2026-09-23
